close_reason: not_found_json helper extracted to src/helpers.rs; all 5 get-handler call sites updated to use it inline
description: The pattern 'if not_found.is_empty() { None } else { Some(not_found.iter().map(|id| Value::String(id.as_ref().to_string())).collect()) }' appears identically in mailbox.rs, thread.rs, identity.rs, submission.rs, and email.rs. A one-line helper fn ids_to_json_array(ids: &[Id]) -> Option<Vec<Value>> would eliminate the repetition and the one place where it diverges slightly would be caught at compile time. Suggested: pub(crate) fn opt_id_json_array(ids: &[Id]) -> Value { if ids.is_empty() { Value::Null } else { Value::Array(ids.iter().map(|id| Value::String(id.as_ref().to_string())).collect()) } }
title: not_found_json pattern repeated verbatim across five get-handlers
